name: age_years
description: Applicant age in completed years at application date

name: employment_type
description: Whether the applicant draws a salary or earns business or professional income

name: employer_category
description: Type of employer for salaried applicants (self-employed use not_applicable)

name: monthly_income_inr
description: Net monthly take-home salary, or for self-employed the average monthly net income from ITR and bank statements

name: current_job_months
description: Months with current employer, or business vintage for self-employed

name: city
description: City of residence or work used for city-based rules

name: credit_score
description: Credit bureau score (CIBIL range 300-900); empty means no credit history

name: existing_emi_inr
description: Sum of monthly EMIs on all running loans (bureau report, confirmed by applicant)

name: recent_defaults
description: True if the bureau shows a write-off, settlement or 90+ days overdue in the last 24 months
